Bosch GBH 18V-18 professional cordless rotary hammer features a balanced power-to-weight ratio. Compact, lightweight design enables overhead drilling, and the robust components and brushless motor contribute to its durability. Also features anti-vibration system, LED work light and soft-grip handle. Supplied with auxiliary handle and depth stop.
